def plugin(path: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Reads path and notes/../secret.txt through fs and returns both joined by '|'.
    A read that fails yields an empty string."""
    post "|" in out
    mine = fs.read(path) else ""
    theirs = fs.read("notes/../secret.txt") else ""
    return mine + "|" + theirs

def run_plugin(path: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Runs plugin(path) with fs narrowed to the notes directory, so every
    read outside notes yields an empty string."""
    post "|" in out
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        return plugin(path)
